summary: Castellum, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce the scheduling of its second quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The earnings results will be published on August 6, 2026, after market close, with a conference call on August 7, 2026, at 10:00 am ET. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report with no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors named. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 contains only logistical details for shareholders and analysts to access the call. This is standard corporate communication unrelated to any special-situation category.
